reviews.text: Kay in the front office was so accommodating and kind. She helped me out with my new dog!

I had a great experience here! Everyone was so nice, welcoming, and made both me and my dog feel comfortable. The staff was caring and took great care of my dog. I really appreciate how kind everyone was. I’ll definitely be coming back, and I love the community here. Highly recommend!
Always takes great care with my dog Stella
Excellent, friendly staff who care deeply about what they do
Great pet doctors. This is where I take my Siberian Husky, named Frankie. He got his rabies shot and parvo shots here. Look how happy he looks.
Valley West Animal Hospital is the best! Dr Cromer and staff are always caring and amazing! Best veterinarian Highly recommend them
One of the best veterinarians I’ve been to highly recommend them

We came a few years ago to spay my cat, and this year we came because she had an ear infection. They do a good job, they took very good care of her and they were very kind!! Their price’s aren’t too expensive.
Took a stray dog in to get it, scanned for a microchip, and they were very willing to do that for me at no cost. And we were able to locate the dog's owner.

A true gem of a place! They pricing is more then fair, the vet and vet techs were  so knowledgeable and kind, Kay, the receptionist was friendly and efficient! I really cannot express in words my relief to find a good vet for my pets!!
We love Dr Cromer. She can never retire! We’ve used her for over 7 years.

I specifically made the appointment for my cat to get his anal glands expressed because they are built up pretty bad and to get his last rabies shot. The rabies shot wasn’t the main reason I even called. And they didn’t even wrote it down to do it. Now my cat is upset and they told me to come in another day to do it. Make sure you repeat yourself a bunch when setting up an appointment with them.
Excellent customer service and excellent care for my pup!

You will not find a better Vet and Staff.  Amy Cromer is the best for knowing how to make your pet feel better.  The staff is caring and knowledgeable.  Don't go Corporate Vet go Independent Vet - it is the best for your animal!
The team and Dr Cromer take good care of my sweet old cat and have helped her to gain weight and thrive again. I appreciate that they have care credit too.

Having been taking my dogs there for years, they have taken good care of Snickers  old English Sheep dog , Molly terrier, Boots, mixed breed,
Valentine,.Old English Sheep dog, Ali, dalmatian,  they were are babies & Family,  Now has a tumor above his eye, Now I have the hard decision to let my dear Bayley go,
I highly  recommend  this Veterinary service, wonderful,caring,loving,
First time here, workers are very kind and I feel comfortable trusting them with my kitty

Dr. Cromer and her team are wonderful: Compassionate-Efficient-Patient. Dr. Cromer is very thorough and answers all questions without being rushed.

X-rays and Labs are done in house-with results in 10-15 min.

A friend from recommended Dr. Cromer after hearing how much the other vet charged for everything and how they recommended multiple tests and  labs while my dog’s kidney lab values were getting worse. On the first visit Dr. Cromer stopped one of the injections he was getting for a year at the other vet’s because it can cause kidney issues. Since then his kidney labs have improved significantly.

My vet bills are 1/3 to 1/2 less now. I don’t feel taken advantage of when I pay.

Most of all- I am confident that my dog is getting the excellent care he needs and that we both are treated with genuine respect and kindness.

I highly recommend Dr. Cromer and her team with complete confidence.

This is the best vet I've ever been to. They were able to get me into an appointment within 2 days, expertly examined my dog and found that she had contracted a virus. She felt better after a round of some meds and a bland diet after about a week of treatment. The total was around $250.

After being a loyal customer to Banfield Pet Hospital for over 4 years, I stopped into to a Banfield, saw no vet and minimally explained the issue, & was quoted $1.3k for several tests. I left, was charged $75 for nothing. I was being scammed by Banfield and needed my dog to get the care she deserved. That's when I found West valley animal hospital out of recommendation from my bf.

My dog is 100% better and it's thanks to this vet. Thank you for having such a friendly and personal receptionist, passionate vet techs and a knowledgeable vet who actually speaks to patients owners. Thanks for putting people and pets first!
Good
I had a very good time here. They helped me out. They did a great job with Sami
Very gentle with Anakin, he is a nervous dog but did great. Thank you for everything 🫶🏻 …
I think I found the spot for my dogs

We started when it was Welty/matchetteans a trainer ms coiner . They are the dog whispers no doubt. Dr Amy an staff have taken care of us and of fur babies for decades and wouldn’t go anywhere else. You always take care of us and our animals I wouldn’t go anywhere else- you are the best.love & hugs George/Barbara Ross thank you a million times

I'm so grateful 2 have found a place that cares 4 my beloved Travis's healrh. I've trusted the Doc  & her staff for over 10 yrs in their skills & concerns 4 the well being of Travis. Yes, I know that vet costs have gone up so much these days, but the quality of their expertise & their affection 4 the animals in their care only gets better!  One can pay their bill with  confidence knowing that their loved one has been seen, evaluated & treated by a doctor who knows her  craft & applys her wisedom & genuine concern on their beloved fur baby. Even tho I've relocated 40 mins away from Phx, & have had the opportunity 2 go somewhere else, I STILL drive the long distance 2 take my fur baby back each time he needs 2 be seen by the Doc, she has gained my trust over the years. Her place of business is small, cozy & clean, no fancy furniture nor fancy ofc equipment nor a cold, stern environment. It contains a wonderful, friendly staff with genuine smiles who like what they R doing at their jobs. I'm happy 2 give a good report for the Valley West Animal Hospital, I should have done so many years ago. Thx u, Doc, for all the years u & yur staff have cared 4 my lil Travis & all the others fur babies  u have cared 4 over the yrs.

This is the best vet in AZ. The staff up front is so friendly and welcoming. The technician is an angel the way she talks and interacts with my kitties makes me feel so safe for them. You can tell she’s passionate about animals and wanting to keep them healthy and safe. Dr Cromer is so professional and sweet. They always take care of us and our fur babies so well. They explain all medicine throughly and make sure you understand. The building is always clean and they do so well with scheduling it is never packed and there is never a long wait. I like how small it is as a person that deals with anxiety.

I’ve tried many vets in the valley and they all have long waits are overly packed and the staff is unwelcoming and condescending.
I am so happy to have found Valley West Animal Hospital as they are now my forever vet choice.
Thank you Dr Cromer and staff. Keep up the great work and service!

Forever a loyal customer :)

horrible experience neutering our kitten. there were “complications” during surgery, and when they called to tell us, they went on for minutes before saying “he’s ok.” i literally thought he’d died for a brief time. then when we picked him up, he was absolutely covered in his own urine and feces - they’d just let him sit in his own filth all day long. these people are cruel and don’t know how to treat animals. i will say that the vet assistant was really nice though - she was the reason we came back for the neuter, but the vet herself is the reason we’ll never be back.

I have been taking my furry godlings to Dr. Cromer since 1975.  She and her staff have always been caring and very professional for my dogs and for me too.  Dr. Cromer always takes the time to explain everything and always uses common sense when recommending treatment.  I appreciate her and her team and recommend them without hesitation.  If you are looking for a doctor who puts your pet and you first....she and her team are the ones.
Very nice staff and affordable.  Helped me with meds to move my cat across the country too.

Went in for vaccines and preventative care. I only got to see the vet at the end of the appointment briefly to speak about my dogs dental hygiene, which was fair because it was bad. But I left without my dogs probiotics. When they reached out, they said to just buy them on Amazon, but I needed them to be a part of the appointment. Overall, I just didn't feel they cared about my animals because dental hygiene as bad as it is was not a gastro problem that I was seeking preventative care for. I'll be taking my boys elsewhere.

I cannot say enough great things about West Valley Animal Hospital! I recently brought my dog, Rocky, in to get an international health certificate, and Dr. Bhullar and her amazing team went above and beyond to ensure everything was done perfectly. They were incredibly thorough, professional, and compassionate, making Rocky feel at ease throughout the process.

What really stood out to me was how affordable their prices are without compromising the quality of care. It’s clear that this team genuinely cares about their patients and their families.

If you’re looking for a veterinary clinic that provides top-notch care with a personal touch, West Valley Animal Hospital is the place to go. Thank you, Dr. Bhullar and team, for taking such great care of Rocky! Highly recommend!

Dr Amy Cromer is extremely knowledgeable and provides excellent care!  Also the fees are quite reasonable compared to many other veterinary practices here in the valley.  I highly recommend Valley West.
Zero stars if I could. The word hospital should not be in your name, they are by appointment only. Making this review on a Monday and the 1st appointment available is until Thursday.
If I could I would put zero starts, title of so called "hospital" that's appointments only that Is not how a hospital works
It was great

I trust Dr Amy and her staff. Very straight forward, no nonsense vet. I worked in the field for 20 years and have seen fantastic vets and vets that I wouldn't let touch my stuffed animals. Very prompt responding to questions and scheduling appointments. If you need a good doc. for your fur babies, give Valley West a go.

Dr cromer was awesome! She was able to squeeze my dog RAIDER  in on her lunch break the following day effortlessly for something most places would have charged me double for not including the emergency fees that others would have tacked on . Her and her staff has been great every step of the way !!

They really do their best to take care of us. My rascal injured his leg. I called & got an appointment for the next day because he was favoring so much. We have a 2.5 hr trip with a lot of traffic. They provide a quiet exam room to help my furry friend calm down after the drive. He enjoys the gals so much that when they turned their back to prepare supplies for the splint he told them he needed their love & affection instead. He was so at ease he wanted to share cuddles with them instead of being afraid. Apparently they acquiesced because he bounded back in to the exam room quite proud of himself. The goober.
We have had Dr. amy as his vet for 3 years. Always had good service & care. Easy instructions for take home care. I am well pleased & am thankful Dr. Amy, Tanya, Rosie & Toni do such a great job.
I bring all my boxers(all.4) here since they have been born and the vet  and helpers here is so good with them..
